observed_probe_regression.environment: GKE Autopilot cold-start deployments in staging and PDT
symptoms: gRPC readiness and liveness probes exceeded their implicit one-second timeout
emailservice was killed by liveness and accumulated repeated exit-137 restarts
PDT repetitions 2 and 3 remained unhealthy after their single authorized retries
observed_probe_regression.root_cause: The Python services had no startup probe and used the Kubernetes default one-second timeout for both readiness and liveness during cold start.

observed_oracle_regression.root_cause: The workflow gated Oracle on the paired job result and human-gate output, but did not require status.json.state to equal completed.
observed_oracle_regression.effect: Oracle was scheduled for a pipeline that had already terminated as completed-excluded and then failed closed before label access.

remediation.probe_contract: Add a bounded 120-second gRPC startup window and explicit five-second timeouts to readiness and liveness for emailservice and recommendationservice in both manifest bases.
remediation.oracle_contract: Expose the paired pipeline state as a job output and require pipeline_state == completed before scheduling Oracle.
